# Code of Conduct

## Our Pledge

We are committed to making participation in the Domoticz-PiHole-Control project a welcoming, respectful, and constructive experience for everyone.

We welcome contributions from people of all experience levels, whether you are reporting a problem, testing the plugin against your Pi-hole, improving documentation, or contributing code.

## Our Standards

Examples of behaviour that contributes to a positive environment include:

- Being respectful, patient, and constructive.
- Accepting feedback and differing technical opinions gracefully.
- Providing clear, factual information when reporting problems.
- Helping other users where possible.
- Respecting the privacy and security of other contributors.

Unacceptable behaviour includes harassment, personal attacks, insults, discrimination, deliberate disruption, and publishing another person's private information without permission.

## Project-Specific Expectations

When participating in this project:

- Never publish Pi-hole passwords, app passwords, session ids, or other authentication secrets.
- Do not publish private host names, public IP addresses, client names or IP addresses from your network, or the contents of your private block lists in issues, pull requests, or logs unless they are needed and you are comfortable sharing them.
- Redact sensitive information before attaching diagnostic output or screenshots.
- Be clear about which Pi-hole version (core, FTL, web), plugin version, and Domoticz version you have tested.
- Do not present untested functionality as confirmed to work.
- Remember that the Pi-hole API can change between Pi-hole releases.

## Scope

This Code of Conduct applies to the project's issue tracker, pull requests, discussions, and other community spaces when representing or participating in the project.

## Enforcement

Project maintainers are responsible for clarifying and enforcing these standards.

Maintainers may edit or remove inappropriate content, close discussions, reject contributions, or restrict participation when necessary.

If you experience or witness unacceptable behaviour, contact the project maintainer privately through an appropriate GitHub contact channel.

Reports will be handled as confidentially as reasonably possible.

## Attribution

This Code of Conduct is inspired by the Contributor Covenant and adapted for the Domoticz-PiHole-Control project.
